games.title: Killshot
games.tag: online multiplayer · first person · up to 8
games.desc: Killshot is Ember's online first-person shooter for up to eight players. The new Breach-12 shotgun joins eight weapons with individual sights, zoom, accuracy and reload animations. Read LIFE and ammunition at a glance, collect health and ammo boxes, and keep collected weapons in rebindable slots 1–9 until death. A circular countdown shows reload progress. Classic starts with a sidearm; Custom loadout lets the host choose a shared starting weapon independently of free for all, 4v4 team deathmatch or king of the hill. Slide, slide-jump and chain wall kicks through three hand-authored maps, including the vertical 96 × 96 m Breakwater Harbor with enterable port buildings and rooftop routes. Five HP, head-sized headshots and a timed shield. Sunlight, shadows, clouds, weather, spatial sound and gamepad support. Settings includes sensitivity, key bindings and fullscreen.

versions.note: Breach-12 shotgun: eight pellets per shell, six-shell magazine, pump action and individual reload; slot 8 pickups and custom starting loadout with existing Killshot HUD and controls preserved
Killshot: LIFE and ammo HUD, health and ammo boxes, per-weapon reload animations and circular timer, retained weapon slots 1–9, Classic or custom starting loadout
vertical Breakwater Harbor: enterable port buildings, rooftop routes and wall-jump lanes; sprint-crouch sliding, momentum-preserving slide jumps and chained wall kicks
personal controls: saved key bindings and mouse sensitivity, five HP without floating health bars, head-sized headshot detection, a three-second shield with firing recovery and reuse cooldown
grounded environments: local contact shading at cover bases, warehouse corners and raised roof junctions across all three maps; existing sun, weather and gameplay preserved
first material polish: view-dependent metal and paint highlights, matte concrete, dry-weather sky reflection on harbor water, consistent crane paint and linear-light texture filtering
Breakwater Harbor: a hand-authored 96 × 96 m tactical port for eight players, with a moored ship, cranes, container routes, proper large-map collision and 4 m/s walking

aim, settle, fire: individual weapon zoom and sight animations, ADS plus crouch accuracy, movement penalties, recovering spread, a weaker starter sidearm and slower ground movement with preserved jumps
hands on the weapon: per-gun posed gloves and fingers, textured sleeves, and arm IK that keeps other players holding their weapons while aiming and crouching
skies and weather: directional sun, cast shadows, drifting clouds, sheltered rain, fading smoke and wet-surface sky reflections
boots: a footstep on every plant of the walk animation, a heavier and louder one at a sprint, silence while crouched at any speed, all panned and delayed by distance like the guns

the realism pass: rounds at real muzzle velocity stopped by the first thing on their path, tracers and impacts by material from shot events, layered gunshots panned and delayed by distance, the supersonic crack of a near miss
modes: free for all to 20 frags, team deathmatch to 30 with blue and red, king of the hill to 60 on the dock and the plinth; rounds end and restart after a 10 s pause
Freight Yard: seven guns looted by bonking ? blocks from below on both maps (Trench City's pads are gone), finite ammo, a map per lobby, gamepads and rumble
the scutum on Q, first person and on every player who raises one; the Murasama on E, a real cut
one operator: the rifle the character carries, in its own gloved hands; E strikes with the butt
the heavy revolver and real hands - cylinder, hammer and trigger move

games.title: End Game
games.tag: single player · dark fantasy · controller + touch
games.desc: Awaken in a detailed castle prison. Explore weathered masonry, aged timber and handmade ironwork, slip past the sleeping warden and claim the greatsword. Controller, keyboard/mouse and touch controls with adaptive resolution.

versions.note: The Dread Warden: a generated textured jailer, stronger silhouette and weighted rise, pursuit and knife animations
The Warden’s Voice: spoken reactions to noise, the cell key, the greatsword and defeat, with subtitles and dialogue priority
The warden rises, draws his knife and attacks with dodgable strikes
Heavy directional sword strikes, buffered rhythm combos and hit feedback
Articulated wolf gauntlets, finger grips and timed item pickups
The Living Cell: generated stone and oak surfaces, detailed furnishings, fitted masonry, moving chains, cloth and dripping water
The Awakening: a playable prison escape, wolf and werewolf armor, greatsword, prologue, torch lighting and adaptive resolution

games.title: UltimateLegue
games.desc: Fight for the Crystalforge in a top-down browser arena. Five champions bring distinct abilities and auto attacks to an ivory bridge between rival cores. Claim the North and South Courts, earn gold, build six items and shape your rune page. Play alone with bots or join an online lobby. V3 adds right-click orders, bindable attack move and an Escape menu with fullscreen, controls and a complete tutorial. Discover the champions and their connected stories in the new trailer and world page.

versions.note: Crystalforge environment pass: broad stone paving, layered plazas and clearer landmarks; open spell effects, order markers and confirmed combat feedback.
Right-click move and attack, bindable attack move, ability animation takeover, and an Escape menu with fullscreen, key bindings and a complete new-player guide
Crystalforge: five fleet-created champions, a textured garden arena, distinct combat animations, redesigned HUD and saved keybindings
first build: one lane, five champions, draft with rune pages and summoner spells, courts, cores, a shop, and bots

games.title: Fire Racer
games.desc: GT circuit racing with a tactical twist. Choose a balanced GT, agile lightweight or powerful muscle car, then race seven opponents through the castle circuit. Collect mystery boxes for Nitro, Shield, Pulse, Oil and Grip. Build drift boosts, trade paint, and fight for the finish over three laps. WASD drives, Space drifts, Shift boosts, E uses your item, R recovers.

versions.note: GT Circuit V2: three vehicles, tactical items, contact physics, garage and rematches

games.title: Four Kings
games.tag: online, turn based, 2-4 players, 15 s turns
games.desc: Four-corner chess on a 10x10 board: king, queen, two rooks, two bishops, a knight and seven pawns per corner, plus two new legends. The Joker teleports between mirror tiles, is placed anywhere every fifth turn, and captures on exactly one tile, its front-left. The Hero sleeps in the corner until it trades places with one of your pawns and wakes as a rook-plus-knight. Pawns march forward or left and capture on three diagonals, so a corner formation is never a wall. One action per 15-second turn, three timeouts and you are out, last king standing wins. Click a piece, click a highlighted target; Esc clears. Swap your legend and epic cards within their class before the game starts.

versions.note: first build: within-class card swap, 15 s turns

games.title: what is this?
games.tag: local diagnostic · browser + hardware · optional upload
games.desc: A playful, staged answer to a practical question: what kind of machine and browser is this? Runs fixed wasm CPU and timing kernels, records floating-point and feature fingerprints, and keeps going when a probe is unavailable. The complete JSON report can stay on your device; sending it to the Ember server is a separate, explicit choice.

versions.note: nine-stage diagnostic suite, now with a Julibrot fast-slide test; report submission remains optional

games.title: Julibrot Lab
games.desc: A four-dimensional slice viewer with every delivered limit and measurement left visible. WebGL2 with EXT_color_buffer_float is required.

versions.note: updated slice viewer: saved-view application, retained frames across partition changes, and visible limits and measurements
